title: Dances and Bunk not dancing
summary: She never missed a dance in Lake Charles; Bunk played for dancers but would not dance himself except when drunk.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: That's all the musical experience that I had.
Did you go to many dances? I'm not trying to get personal and all that, but I just want to mention.

Oh, when I was in Lake Charles, I didn't used to miss a dance. You didn't miss something in your life, though. No. But that's where I probably met him at a dance in West Hall. This hall was on, what street now? Franklin, not Franklin Street. I could go to the prison. It's been so long. I can't remember all the things. Tell me this.
Did Bunk ever dance with you? He never did dance.

He never did dance. I didn't think so. He always said that he played music for you to dance, but he wouldn't dance. He wouldn't, you never saw him out on the floor to dance. But the only thing he would dance if he'd get high and he'd be in a ballroom or something in a jukebox or something like that. Oh yeah, a jukebox or something like that. He'd get there and dance. But otherwise, like men would come down and get somebody their seat. He never did do that. He wouldn't come down and dance with you?
No. No. No. No. No. No.
No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
No. No. No. No. No. No.
Just about five years he was out of a horn.
